title: Curves of tangencies of foliation pairs and normalizing transformations
summary: In this work we give a complete description of the collection of curves of tangencies induced by germs of foliation pairs -- non dicritical and dicritical -- given by analytic differential equations with degenerated non dicritical and dicritical singularities, satisfying some genericity assumptions. To this purpose we use local models and analytic normalizing transformations. Moreover, for each natural number $k$ we obtain $k$-normal forms for the normalizing transformations.
